external_deps: Xinference, Ollama, LocalAI, FastChat or One API

review.tagline: Local knowledge-base Q&A and agent app built on LangChain
review.summary: Chatchat answers questions over your own files by splitting, embedding and retrieving text, then passing the top-k matches to an LLM. It does not load models itself: it connects to Xinference, Ollama, LocalAI, FastChat or One API through OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It ships a FastAPI backend and a Streamlit WebUI, and installs with pip install langchain-chatchat.
review.audience: Chinese-language users self-hosting offline document Q&A with local LLMs
strengths: Connects to Xinference, Ollama, LocalAI, FastChat and One API via OpenAI-compatible endpoints
FAISS by default, other vector stores selectable in kb_settings.yaml
Also has agent tools, search-engine chat, database chat and image chat with qwen-vl-chat
weaknesses: Needs a separate model server running before the knowledge base can be built
Last release 2024-07-12; README Docker image tag is dated 2024-08-29
Default bind is 127.0.0.1; remote access requires editing basic_settings.yaml
0.3.x differs a lot from 0.2.x; migration is not guaranteed to work
needs: Needs Xinference, Ollama, LocalAI, FastChat or One API, FAISS (default vector store), SQLite (default database)
Models: GLM-4-Chat, Qwen2-Instruct, Llama3, bge-large-zh-v1.5, qwen-vl-chat
